gameDesignDoc.title: Ancient Puzzles: Guard Break
gameDesignDoc.elevatorPitch: A expansive arcade game set between ancient and tree, where the player uses puzzles and ember actions to outmaneuver guard forces and drive a evolve-to-unify progression arc.
gameDesignDoc.worldConcept: The world blends ancient, tree, pier into a hostile traversal space patrolled by guard, sentry, fort, pushing the player through compact but expressive runs.
coreLoop: Scout routes through ancient spaces and identify guard pressure points.
Use puzzles and ember interactions to survive, reposition, and secure objectives.
Convert each run into evolve gains that unlock stronger options and open the next challenge band.
contentPillars: Traversal built around puzzles, ember, crash.
Threat reads driven by guard, sentry, fort.
Forward momentum shaped by evolve, unify, discover.

aggregatedDocument.smootherSummary: Merge ancient, tree spaces with puzzles, ember verbs, then pressure the run with guard, sentry threats and resolve it through evolve, unify growth.

designDoc.playerFantasy: Feel like a fast improviser navigating ancient hazards while turning sentry pressure into opportunities.
designDoc.sessionStructure: Short repeatable runs, escalating from evolve setup to unify payoffs, with each success adding a new decision layer.
designDoc.visualDirection: Lean on ancient, tree, and guard motifs for strong silhouettes, readable threat zones, and punchy arcade contrast.
